nodes.label: Three-layer skill split (definition / cast context / skill user)
nodes.rationale: Any entity (player or enemy) must be able to use the same skill definition; reuse requirement dictates the split.

nodes.label: SkillDefinition (immutable Resource .tres)
nodes.rationale: Never references input, player, mouse, collision layer or faction so it stays reusable.

nodes.label: ProjectileSkillDefinition
nodes.rationale: Archetype expressed as SkillDefinition subclass so each archetype gets its own [Export] fields.

nodes.label: CastContext (per-cast context)
nodes.rationale: Seam that lets one definition serve both sides; carries aim, faction, mutable params and tags.

nodes.label: SkillUser (executor component)
nodes.rationale: Owns loadout, timers, builds cast context, pays costs; player and enemy differ only by input vs AI.

nodes.label: Faction / friendly fire
nodes.rationale: Faction lives in the runtime context so one Fireball asset serves both sides without an enemy duplicate.

nodes.label: Archetype vs tags separation
nodes.rationale: Avoid PoE's conflation: archetype decides executor behaviour, tags are labels for filtering/scaling. Executors must not branch on tags; scaling must.

nodes.label: Skill tags ([Flags] enum)
nodes.rationale: Flags enum is fast and typo-proof; capped at 64 values; strings rejected for silently accepting typos.

nodes.label: Triggered provenance tag
nodes.rationale: Stamped per cast by the skill user when the cast came from a trigger; never authored; justifies mutable tag copy.

nodes.label: DamageDeliveryKind (Hit | OverTime)
nodes.rationale: DoT tag vs payload delivery kind don't line up; avoids +DoT buffing the hit portion.

nodes.label: Structural vs descriptive tags
nodes.rationale: Attack/Spell become structural because they drive speed scaling; descriptive tags stay free to re-tag.

nodes.label: Skill base damage with caster Flat/Increased/More modifiers
nodes.rationale: Skill owns the base number, caster owns the modifiers; same Stat formula as stats.md.

nodes.label: Added damage effectiveness
nodes.rationale: PoE rule: flat damage multiplied by per-skill effectiveness so fast small-base skills don't gain disproportionately.

nodes.label: Classes differ only by tree and start position
nodes.rationale: Simplest model supporting distinct classes and one definition for everyone; class balance becomes a tree problem.

nodes.label: AttackSpeed and CastSpeed stats
nodes.rationale: Two speed stats make the same affix best-in-slot for one build and dead for another, turning gear into a fit decision.

nodes.label: ResolveSpeedStat(tags) tag-derived speed
nodes.rationale: Reverses pass two's SpeedStat field: tag is the contract the player reads; deriving from one source makes divergence unauthorable.

nodes.label: Damage payload object
nodes.rationale: TakeDamage(float) would force rewrites for DoT, status, triggers, damage numbers.

nodes.label: Cost entry list (Flat / PercentOfMax / PercentOfCurrent)
nodes.rationale: A list supports hybrid costs and cost-converting modifiers; percent modes keep life cost risk constant across levels.

nodes.label: All-or-nothing cost payment with life floor 1
nodes.rationale: A skill can never kill its caster: self-kill reads as a bug.

nodes.label: IgnoresResourceCosts actor flag
nodes.rationale: Enemies paced by AI cadence and cooldowns; avoids silent never-attacking enemies or free rides for misconfigured players.

nodes.label: Cooldown (authored per skill)
nodes.rationale: Only rate governor for skills tagged neither Attack nor Spell (dash, warcry).

nodes.label: CooldownRecovery stat (rate divisor)
nodes.rationale: Divisor is asymptotic and never reaches zero, unlike subtractive -X% cooldown; otherwise cooldown skills don't scale.

nodes.label: Cooldown starts on cast start
nodes.rationale: Matches player expectation, avoids cast speed double-dipping as cooldown reduction; PoE precedent.

nodes.label: Charges (MaxCharges, charge-shaped cooldown state)
nodes.rationale: State shape (chargesAvailable, rechargeTimer) decided now because every reader depends on it.

nodes.label: Six-slot loadout (1-4, LMB, RMB)
nodes.rationale: Uniform slot semantics; D3 role-locked slots were disliked and removed.

nodes.label: Right-click conflict resolution (LMB Move, RMB skill, force_move)
nodes.rationale: PoE-style default Move occupant on LMB; WASD's unconditional priority de-risks losing click-to-move.

nodes.label: BuiltInAction.Move sentinel
nodes.rationale: Move as full skill rejected for now (continuous state vs discrete cast); sentinel keeps door open.

nodes.label: Hold-to-repeat input with per-skill timers, no GCD
MovementDuringUse field (Free/Slowed/Rooted)
nodes.rationale: Free movement while casting is easy to add, hard to remove; field is the escape hatch.

nodes.label: Linear projectile first skill spec
nodes.rationale: Direction locked at cast, no homing or auto-aim; aim assist would belong in the aim source.

nodes.label: Already-hit target set
nodes.rationale: Two lines at pierce 0 that make pierce, chain and fork correct later.

nodes.label: The six seams for skills affecting skills
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy isn't a blocker; leave holes for every interaction mechanism.

nodes.label: Seam 1: per-cast mutable parameter block
nodes.rationale: Mutating a shared Resource corrupts it for every caster.

nodes.label: Seam 3: GetModifiers(query) / ModQuery
nodes.rationale: Retrofitting conditions later means changing every call site.

nodes.label: Seam 6: CastModifier behaviour transforms
nodes.rationale: Build-defining upgrades are behaviour transforms on the per-cast block, not numeric stat modifiers; order-dependent.

nodes.label: CastModifier Priority ordering rule
nodes.rationale: Stable sort by priority, tie-broken by source; avoids nondeterministic balance bugs.

nodes.label: OnHitOutcomeKind.Fork
nodes.rationale: Fork turns one projectile into two, so it can't be a Redirect.

nodes.label: SkillInstance (definition + Attached + charge state)
nodes.rationale: Loadout must hold instances so upgrades attach without a schema migration.

nodes.label: Keep Flat/Increased/More formula
nodes.rationale: Stable middle between additive and multiplicative stacking; diverge on vocabulary instead.

nodes.label: Game-state conditions on modifiers
nodes.rationale: Build defined by how you play rather than keyword stacking; rides ModQuery seam.

nodes.label: Where build depth comes from
nodes.rationale: Combinatorial axes give superlinear build depth per authoring hour for a solo dev.

nodes.label: Hell Clock (reference game)
nodes.rationale: Lesson: character-wide items naming a specific skill are mostly dead drops; build systems must not be the only fun.

nodes.label: Axis B: tag-gated artifact sockets on skills
nodes.rationale: Attach to skill instance with tag-scoped generic modifiers: amortizes authoring, no compatibility matrix, avoids dead relics.

nodes.label: Axis D: dual class
nodes.rationale: Requires separate per-class trees; must decide before tree authoring.

nodes.label: Priority order milestones 1-4
nodes.rationale: Load-bearing structure first, then minimum to evaluate, then content, then depth axes; gear before tree.

nodes.label: Projectile capability list (count, spread, pierce, forks, chains, bounces, homing...)
Fork vs split naming
nodes.rationale: Fork happens on hit, split at cast; rename frees words.

nodes.label: Bounces (off geometry, not viewport)
nodes.rationale: Screen-edge bounce differs per player/monitor; geometry composes with Redirect outcomes.

nodes.label: Fork test validated by reintroducing the bug
Mana regeneration and cost rework
nodes.rationale: Level-1 Arcanist could cast Fireball forever; costs now require mana management.

nodes.label: Skill upgrade trees (gold levels to 20, three branches)
nodes.rationale: Points per gem level; rejected character-level points, shared tree, free respecs.

hyperedges.label: Cast pipeline: copy params/tags, collect & apply CastModifiers, resolve costs/stats, execute
